contract_summary: Proposed source-audited semantic contract for typed authority vectors, audience separation, protocol invariants, and cryptography by role. G1 freeze is pending workload mapping resolution.

S.symbol: S_e = S_SC ∩ S_H ∩ S_R ∩ S_T ∩ S_P

A.symbol: A_e = A_SC ∩ A_H ∩ A_R ∩ A_T ∩ A_P
A.syntax: Synthetically partitioned Berka account IDs (e.g., ACC-1001, ACC-1002)

V.description: Authorization validity interval [V_start, V_end] in Unix epoch seconds
V.empty_rule: If min(V_end) < max(V_start), result is empty interval (rejection)

D.description: Canonical AIS data selection predicate (transaction window, filters, fields, pagination)
D.symbol: D_e = D_SC ⊓ D_H ⊓ D_R ⊓ D_T ⊓ D_P

projection_rules.forbidden_fields_policy: Fail-closed. Any response containing unapproved fields (such as 'unapproved_field', 'ssn', or internal debug flags) must be rejected immediately with UNAUTHORIZED_FIELD_OVERDISCLOSURE.
projection_rules.field_masking: If specific fields are requested in D_e, only the exact intersection of requested and permitted fields may be returned by the Resource Server.

account_filter.rule: Strict subset constraint. Returned accounts must be a subset of authorized accounts A_e. Any foreign or unauthorized account (e.g. ACC-999) must cause immediate rejection with UNAUTHORIZED_ACCOUNT_IN_RESPONSE.

time_range_filter.rule: Temporal bound enforcement. Transaction queries are constrained by [from_date, to_date] where max transaction window = history_window_days (default 90 days). Transactions outside [V_start, V_end] window must not be disclosed.

input_authorities.SC: Scope VC issued by Bank Issuer during F1 enrollment
input_authorities.H: Holder approval granted via Wallet during F3 consent
input_authorities.R: TPP request submitted in F2 / F4
input_authorities.T: Registered TPP regulatory bounds maintained by Bank Directory
input_authorities.P: Active Bank Policy enforced dynamically by DAS

Aud_KB.name: Key Binding Audience
Aud_KB.target: DAS Verifier Identifier in SD-JWT Key Binding Proof

challenge_binding.type: Cryptographic signed challenge issued by DAS in F2

nonce_binding.type: Holder-bound cryptographic nonce in SD-JWT KB
nonce_binding.rule: Must match DAS challenge nonce strictly

replay_prevention.rule: Sequential or concurrent duplicate presentations of the same F4 assertion / challenge must be rejected (single-use consumption).
replay_prevention.idempotency: Subsequent identical queries within same transaction boundary return logged receipt, never re-issue fresh authority.

selective_disclosure.das_encryption: ECDH-ES / Hybrid ML-KEM encrypted package for DAS-only claims

B1-C0.transport: Current TLS certificate scripts use ECDSA P-384; transport is recorded separately from application JWS roles

B1-C2.dual_signature_rule: Both classical and PQ signatures must be valid. Classical-only fallback is prohibited.

vocabulary_mapping.description: Bi-directional mapping between Open Banking standard AIS permissions, OAuth scopes, and service endpoints

open_banking_uk_rules.transaction_permission_pairing: ReadTransactionsBasic or ReadTransactionsDetail requires at least one of ReadTransactionsCredits or ReadTransactionsDebits.
open_banking_uk_rules.direct_debits: ReadDirectDebits is valid and maps to the specified /accounts/{AccountId}/direct-debits and /direct-debits resources. These endpoints are not implemented by the current three Resource Servers and are excluded from the core workload.

resource_projection.description: Canonical AIS account projection served by every resource server. Values come from the Berka dataset; they are never derived from the access token.
resource_projection.account_identity: Canonical ACC-NNN maps one-to-one onto the Berka internal account id (ACC-001 <-> account_id 1).
resource_projection.record_source: One record per authorized account, built from that account's most recent booked movement in trans, ordered by date then trans_id.

fields.account_id: Canonical ACC-NNN identifier of the account
fields.amount: amount of the most recent movement, 2 decimals
fields.balance: balance after the most recent movement, 2 decimals
fields.date: date of the most recent movement as 19YY-MM-DD
fields.operation: operation column of the most recent movement
fields.type: Credit when the movement type is PRIJEM, otherwise Debit

resource_projection.entitlement_rule: Effective authority narrows what the holder owns and never widens it: the projection is the intersection of the granted accounts with the holder's disposition rows, ordered by account id and truncated to page_size.
resource_projection.out_of_bounds_rule: An account that exists but is not reachable by the holder is refused with HTTP 403 and REJECT_RESOURCE_ACCESS_OUT_OF_BOUNDS. HTTP 404 means the account does not exist and is never evidence of an authorization decision.

presentation_binding.description: F4 presentation binding: the Authorization VP commits to the exact evidence it presents and to the challenge it answers.

digest_by_profile.B1-C2: SHA-384, matching the KB-JWT sd_hash digest of the hybrid profile

presentation_binding.verifier: DAS, recomputed from the artifacts that actually arrived

issuance_record_binding.description: How a presented Scope VC is matched against the issuance record committed at F1.
issuance_record_binding.identity_rule: The credential jti and the SHA-256 digest of the issuer-signed component must both equal the values committed at F1; a difference is REJECT_MISMATCHED_ISSUANCE_RECORD.
issuance_record_binding.substituted_key_rule: When the Delegation VC does not verify under the Holder key from the issuance record, a key advertised inside the presentation (wallet_ec_jwk, holder_key_hint) is tried only to classify the rejection as REJECT_SUBSTITUTED_HOLDER_KEY. The advertised key is never accepted as a verification key, and its mere presence is not a failure.
issuance_record_binding.test_assistance: The conformance signer re-commits the issuance record only when a request sets rebind_issuance_record. Cases that rely on it declare issuance_record_rebind in test_assistance.

b0_per_account_consent.description: How the traditional FAPI baseline expresses per-account authority for the matched AIS task.
b0_per_account_consent.mechanism: Optional client scopes holder-approved-acc-NNN, included in the token scope. Their union is the account constraint; without any of them the grant covers everything the holder is entitled to.
b0_per_account_consent.rar_note: Keycloak 24.0.5 does not echo RFC 9396 authorization_details into the access token, so RAR cannot carry the account constraint in this baseline. The resource server still reads authorization_details and the accounts claim when present.
b0_per_account_consent.certificate_binding: cnf.x5t#S256 is produced by Keycloak from the TLS client certificate presented at the token endpoint (KC_HTTPS_CLIENT_AUTH=request with the nginx x509 lookup). It is not a realm constant.
b0_per_account_consent.uncovered: Keycloak's consent screen is all-or-nothing, so holder-driven partial consent within one authorization request is not expressible in this baseline. The reduction is expressed by the TPP requesting the approved subset after the holder decision recorded at /api/conformance/holder-consent.
